opening.argument: The description directs viewers to Genesis Mining purchases with a 3% discount, and the sampled page presents priced mining packages with hash rates and purchase buttons. This is an actionable commercial offer, tied to a stated investment-and-return pathway: the speaker describes investing $150 for 5M hash and says the calculation would become profitable after 117 days. The speaker also says the contracts have no guarantee and that he would not currently invest. Those cautions do not remove the purchase offer or the stated profitability calculation. The records do not establish actual payouts or losses, or whether the estimates apply to every displayed plan; the case rests on the paid mining offer and the described route from money to projected return.
